mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates stronger consumer spending and economic activity, which directly supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and SPX returns is negative in more than 50% of 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600 thousand units signal a contraction in the housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 600.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 135000) signals a robust economic environment with accommodative policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong labor market
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 20-day SPX returns on the interaction term, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0), the S&P 500 experiences positive 60-day returns due to stronger manufacturing output and corporate earnings growth, but the signal is inactive during contractionary phases.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.0%) signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST > 620.0) and retail sales (RSAFS > 340000.0) signals a strong consumer-driven economic expansion, which together drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 20-day SPX returns on the interaction term, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the S&P 500 tends to have negative 5-day returns due to weak economic growth and reduced corporate earnings, but the signal flips to positive in low unemployment regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
